[[File:Matthew Reed DecipherCon 1999 Insider portrait.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Matthew Reed at [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Rich Handley.]]
'''Matthew Reed''' (also published as '''Matt Reed''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 81 from Huntsville, Al. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was runner-up in the 1999 [[Young Jedi]] World Championship at [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="dc99yj05_1" /> Matthew Reed also played at [[March 2001 Huntsville tournament]] on 10 March 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ORS ISB]], according to Tom Culpepper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1884">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10], DeckTech (Tom "Gand" Culpepper, 12 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ GitHub Pages] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026020443/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-12-damned-if-im-not-a-dumbass-hville-3-10d1884/ Internet Archive].</ref>

He was tournament director of the [[2000 Alabama State Championship]] in Birmingham on 29 April 2000,<ref name="tr-d642">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ GitHub Pages] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027125541/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-al-states-in-birmingham-4-29-00d642/ Internet Archive].</ref> the [[2000 Birmingham Grand Slam]] on 28 October 2000<ref name="tr-d1405">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1405/ birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00], DeckTech (Jody "lordbeow" Rodd, 30 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1405/ GitHub Pages] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025142739/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1405/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="tr-d1410">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 31 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ GitHub Pages] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025142814/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-31-birmingham-grand-slam-10-28-00d1410/ Internet Archive].</ref> and the [[February 2001 Huntsville tournament (17 February)]], which he did not play so that the 14-player field had no bye.<ref name="tr-d1754">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-huntsville-al-02-17-01d1754/ huntsville-al-02-17-01], DeckTech (Andy "Solo337" McClure, 20 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-huntsville-al-02-17-01d1754/ GitHub Pages] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027130053/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-huntsville-al-02-17-01d1754/ Internet Archive].</ref> Jim Colson's announcement of the [[2002 Dagobah Regionals]] at The Deep Comics, Huntsville, on 29 June 2002 named "Jim Colson/Matt Reed" as tournament directors.<ref name="tfn-dag02">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Dagobah_Regional_Scheduled_for_Huntsville_Alabama_66269.asp Dagobah Regional Scheduled for Huntsville, Alabama], TheForce.Net CCG (Jim Colson, posted by Josh, 12 June 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027130201/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Dagobah_Regional_Scheduled_for_Huntsville_Alabama_66269.asp Internet Archive]</ref>
